research.name: Symfony Console
research.note: PHP library for command line output with format-string progress bars, styled tables, result blocks and rewritable output sections.

effects: progress bar built from a format string with custom placeholders, colored bar segments, message line, elapsed time and memory use
output sections that let several progress bars or a table redraw independently in the same terminal
tables with colspan and rowspan cells, box and markdown border styles, and rows appended after render
